Public Function Read(ByVal path As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, t As Chart, s As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Open(path)
    Set t = wb.Worksheets(1).ChartObjects(1).Chart
    s = s & Rt0(t)
    s = s & Rt1(t)
    s = s & Rl0(t)
    s = s & Rl1(t)
    wb.Close False
    Read = s
End Function
